shape-changing interfaces are used in Sci-Fi movies to: reconfigure, transform, adapt and physicalize.

SCI in Sci-Fi movies are used to: (1) reconfigure the shape of an object, (2) physically transform an object from one state into another, (3) adapt an object to a specific situation, (4) and physicalize an object in order to make it tangible.
SCI can be used in four behavioral patterns: reconfiguration, transformation, adaptation, and physicalization, and that Sci-Fi can inspire the design and evaluation of SCI.
